name: search_object_by_name
description: Given a search string, returns the ID of the best matching object in the system of record (a customer, part, or user).

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: The search string, for example a customer name, part name, or username.

returns.name: id
returns.description: The ID of the best matching object.

examples: Get tickets coming from this customer
What is the id of part FE-102?
